messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert INC3267891234 fired for service inference-eu-high-latency — severity: P1. Symptoms: rising 5xx rate, request queue growth in eu-west-1. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC3267891234
pagerduty: Auto-notification sent to rotation: eng-oncall-eu, pinging primary on-call.
lisa: taking this — lisa (oncall) ACKed on PD. jumping on dashboards now :wave:
mike: on standby, grabbing grafana and redis/kvcache dashboards
sara: quick fetch: queue depth up ~3.4x since 2026-03-15T14:02Z, tail latency hitting 6s. Autoscaler shows pending pods with `ImagePullBackOff` on 2 nodes. kubelet logs show repeated image pull timeouts.
neil: customer-impact check: Support saw ~120 unique customers hit intermittent 504s in last 10m. Opened ticket #7891 for Acme Corp (priority). CS alerted.
lisa: can we failover to another region for new traffic? Is cross-region routing enabled for this route? if yes, let's shift until eu cluster stable.
jamie: I can flip the route in Redwood Console. Recommend manual scale first while we assess image issues.
neil: FYI @CS — don't send widespread customer comms yet, we'll update in 15.
mike: running manual scale to increase headroom now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-eu --replicas=8
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep inference-eu
```
mike: scale issued; many pods stuck at `ImagePullBackOff` due to registry timeouts. Node events show `Back-off pulling image "registry.internal/redwood/inference:20260315"` on node-12 node-14.
sara: confirmed. Looks like a transient registry hotspot and a couple nodes with slow docker overlay. Autoscaler attempted to add nodes but kubelet couldn't initialize containers fast enough.
lisa: ok — plan: 1) manual scale + restart problematic nodes 2) temporarily route new traffic to us-east while we replace nodes 3) keep PD incident open and handoff to mike for mitigation
jamie: I'll start draining node-12 and node-14 and trigger replacement. `kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
jamie: draining nodes now, starting new node allocation in the cloud console. will monitor image pulls on new nodes.
mike: taking ownership for the next 30m. i'll post updates every 10m. confirmed 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 2% after scale and partial replacement. queue depth trending down.
incident-bot: PD note: Incident acknowledged by lisa and reassigned to mike (escalation: oncall takeover).
support-bot: Customer comms staged: small notification draft for impacted tenants; will hold until next status update. CS pinged Acme and Beta with interim note.
jamie: new nodes came up, pods scheduled and image pulls healthy on new nodes. one remaining pod failing with `ErrImagePull` referencing a corrupted layer — i'm re-pulling manually.
mike: manual re-pull and restarted pod, logs look good. service-level latency back under SLO for 95p. continuing to watch for 10m.
sara: logs show KV-cache warmup causing higher CPU for a short period, but requests served. no evidence of data plane regression.
lisa: handing off primary to mike — i'm going to join a customer call in 10. mike please escalate to SRE if anything degrades.
mike: got it, i'm primary. current metrics summary: 5xx ~0.7%, p95 latency 320ms, queue depth ~stable. keeping PD incident open until stable for 30m.
neil: CS: Acme on call acknowledged the update, wants ETA for full remediation. we'll send another update once incident is resolved.
incident-bot: automatic update: PD incident still open — triggers suppressed while owner is active.
jamie: follow-up action items I recommend in postmortem: 1) increase image pull parallelism / pre-pull for critical pools 2) bump cluster-autoscaler buffer for inference pools 3) add registry retry/backoff tuning.
lisa: thanks team — great quick ops. Mike, please close PD when metrics stable for 30m and open a postmortem doc with the node/image findings.
mike: will do. creating postmortem draft and linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4567
mike: PD incident will be closed after watch window. final note: root cause appears to be a transient registry degradation causing ImagePullBackOffs and delayed autoscaler warmup; mitigated by manual scaling and node replacement.
lisa: :thumbsup: closing handoff. tagging follow-up owners: @jamie for infra, @sara for telemetry, @neil for CS comms.
jamie: thanks — will push a proposal for image pre-pulls and autoscaler tuning.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD INC3267891234 marked resolved by mike at 2026-03-15T14:47:00Z — watch window started. please verify and file postmortem.
mike: closing thread here; will update postmortem with timeline and RCA. thanks all.
